missing_information_behavior: Do not add a separate iron product until prenatal product contents, current iron use and available blood results are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not duplicate iron already present in prenatal multivitamins.
Do not infer iron-deficiency anemia from pregnancy alone.
Do not replace antenatal screening or prescribed treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Low hemoglobin/ferritin, anemia symptoms, bleeding, gastrointestinal intolerance or suspected iron overload.
Multiple iron-containing products or therapeutic-dose iron use.
population_and_context: Pregnant people; iron requirements rise during pregnancy, but supplementation and dose depend on prenatal care, laboratory status, local policy and existing prenatal products.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Follow local antenatal guidelines and clinician-directed iron/folate policy; account for elemental iron in all products.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet provides pregnancy reference intake and safety information, but universal supplementation policy and dose vary by jurisdiction and antenatal guideline.
